sections.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions:

items.passage: One day, Goha was very hungry, but he didn't have money to buy food. He sat outside a restaurant and enjoyed the smell of the delicious soup. The owner came out and said, "If you enjoy the smell, you must pay for it!" Goha was clever. He took out his coins and shook them. "This is the sound of my payment," he said. "You enjoyed the smell of my soup, and I paid with the sound of my coins." The owner laughed and invited Goha to share the soup.

mcq.question: The owner asked Goha to pay for the ................ .
Goha paid with the sound of his ................ .

questions: Why was Goha hungry?
What did Goha shake?
Do you think Goha is clever? Why?
model_answers: Because he didn't have money to buy food.
Yes, he is clever because he paid with the sound of his coins.
